You want to talk, you can talk to me, but I've got some questions first.|Bow introduces himself|}} [[Clone Lieutenant]] '''Bow''', designated '''CC-2201''', was a [[clone trooper officer]] of the [[501st Legion]] who served during the [[Clone Wars]]. Following the [[Proclamation of the New Order]] that transitioned the [[Galactic Republic]] into the [[Galactic Empire]], Bow served as the second-in-command of [[Shadow Platoon]] under his old [[commander]], [[Clone Commander]] [[Appo]] and [[Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Vader]]. ==Biography== ===Serving the Republic=== {{Quote|There's been a rebellion, sir. Don't worry, the situation is under control.|Appo, to Bail Organa, in front of Bow and other troops|{{Film|III}}}} [[File:Bail Organa Order 66.png|thumb|left|250px|Commander Appo confronts Senator Organa.]] CC-2201 was the designation of a [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]], who was created on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] in order to serve as a [[clone trooper]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] and took on the name Bow. In [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' during the final stages of the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Bow served in the [[501st Legion]] and was part of the [[Appo's battalion|battalion]]''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' created when [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] divided the unit in two; one unit,{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}} of which Bow was part, journeyed to the Republic [[capital]] [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] to [[Battle of Coruscant|reinforce the besieged world]] under Skywalker and [[Clone Commander]] [[Appo]]'s command whereas the other half—the [[332nd Division]]—traveled to the planet [[Mandalore]] under the command of Clone [[Commander]] [[Rex]] so as to assist Skywalker's former [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] in capturing the rogue [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]]. Following the engagement, Appo's [[trooper]]s remained stationed on [[Coruscant]] as [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]], secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] known as Darth Sidious, activated [[Order 66]] to all forces and branded the [[Jedi Order]] as traitors. On the order of [[General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], who had secretly become the [[Sith apprentice]] Darth Vader, the 501st forces on Coruscant laid siege to the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Grand Temple]] in [[Operation: Knightfall]]. Bow was among the hundreds to thousands{{Film|III}} — {{AD|Disney+}} of clone troopers who took part in the operation. [[File:501st-ROTS.png|thumb|right|250px|The surviving troopers, including Bow, fire upon the Jedi Padawan]] The 501st sacked the Temple, [[Death|killing]] all of its inhabitants. Inside, the 501st troopers worked in [[squad]]s to hunt down targets with overwhelming firepower while Vader killed stragglers{{HelmetCollectionCite|16|Helmets}} and fires ignited into a large blaze. Witnessing the unfolding situation, Republic [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa]] travelled to the Jedi Temple in his [[airspeeder]] and set down on a landing pad. A [[Squad|unit]] of clones{{ForceCollection|Clone Sergeant Fox|star=4}} confronted the senator. Bow and his superior officer, Commander Appo, were also present as part of Fox's clone contingent, with Appo ordering the senator to leave. As Organa left, Jedi [[Padawan]] [[Zett Jukassa]] ambushed the group of clones, seriously injuring Appo and taking down six other clones before coming under fire. Bow fired the fatal shot, and Sergeant Fox ordered his troops to let Organa flee. ==Behind the scenes== Bow first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the final film of the [[prequel trilogy]], which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' His scene was filmed on a raised set against a blue screen on Monday, [[July 28]], [[2003]] on Stage 5 at [[Shepperton Studios]].''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]'' Like all clones in the film, he was voiced by [[Temuera Morrison]] and generated using CGI. Bow's name, as well as his designation CC-2201, was established in [[canon]] storytelling more than twenty years later with the release of ''[[Master of Evil]]'', a novel authored by [[Adam Christopher]] and released on [[November 11]], [[2025]]. ''Master of Evil'' establishes that Bow was the clone trooper that fatally shot Zett Jukassa as seen in the events of ''Revenge of the Sith'', however, ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' that released in [[2013]] yet considered as part of canon credited Fox as the one who shot the fatal blaster bolt on Jukassa. As the novel is the more recent source, this article assumes that ''Master of Evil'' is the correct source. ==Appearances== *{{Film|III}} {{1st}} *''[[Master of Evil]]'' {{1stID|Bow and CC-2201}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=CC-2201 }} [[Category:Clone stormtrooper officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Clone trooper lieutenants]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Members of the 501st Legion (Galactic Republic)]]
